Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client

Interface PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration

All Known Implementing Classes:
PlanTypeConfigurationImpl
Enclosing interface:
PbcsApplication
public static interface PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
The number of overloads of PbcsApplication.getPlanType(String) started to proliferate, so there is now a generic configuration object where the plan definition is specified and then passed to the PbcsApplication.getPlanType(PlanTypeConfiguration) method.

As can be noticed in the extensive number of options, there is a fair bit of "ceremony" in constructing a PbcsPlanType object. Some of the objects may carry relatively significant performance penalties (e.g. validating all dimensions). It is recommended that in environments that may be instantiating plan objects repeatedly (e.g. in a data gateway servlet), some form of connection pooling will be used.

  • Method Details

    • getName

      String getName()
      Get name of the plan type (cube).
      Returns:
      the name of the plan type

    • isQueryDimensions

      boolean isQueryDimensions()
      If true, an explicit dimension plan type will be created and the AIF endpoint will be queried to get the list of dimensions to populate. This option is off by default. "Regular" users may not have permissions to query the endpoint, so this method will generally only work for users with Service Administrator privileges and above. If set to true, the value of getExplicitDimensions() will be ignored. Note that attribute dimensions are not returned from this [undocumented] REST endpoint, so if you need attribute dimensions then you should still populate them through getExplicitAttributeDimensions().
      Returns:
      the value for query dimensions

    • isSkipCheck

      boolean isSkipCheck()
      Determines if a check (a REST call) should be performed to validate that the given plan name is actually valid or if we should just assume that it is. You'll get a slightly faster response when creating a PbcsPlanType because you'll skip a REST call.
      Returns:
      true if the validity check should be skipped, false otherwise.

    • isValidateDimensions

      boolean isValidateDimensions()
      If explicit dimensions are defined, then each one will be validated by issuing a "get member" call using the dimension name as the dimension and root member. This does not ensure that a list of dimensions is complete, just that all the defined dimensions are valid.
      Returns:
      true to perform dimension validation

    • getExplicitDimensions

      List<String> getExplicitDimensions()
      The list of explicit dimensions that are being set for the plan. It's not required to set dimensions to use a plan type, but you must set them if you want dimension resolution without a dimension name to work such as in PbcsPlanType.getMember(String).
      Returns:
      the list of explicit (known) dimensions for the plan, empty collection if none are being set

    • getExplicitAttributeDimensions

      List<String> getExplicitAttributeDimensions()
      You can specify a list of dimensions that are explicitly attribute dimensions, and as such their PbcsDimension.getDimensionType() will return PbcsMemberType.ATTRIBUTE. Being able to differentiate attribute dimensions is useful for certain grid parsing operations that may need to know which dimension axes are optional. Not all attribute dimensions have to be specified.
      Returns:
      the list of dimension names that are attribute dimensions

    • getMemberDimensionCache

      PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache getMemberDimensionCache()
      Gets the member dimension cache that will be used for the plan type. The default implementation is generally just a simple InMemoryMemberDimensionCache but for performance or other reasons, the caller may want to specify their own resolver .
      Returns:
      the dimension name cache to use for the plan

    • getMemberResolver

      PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver getMemberResolver()
      Gets the member resolver that has been set for this configuration, if any.
      Returns:
      the member resolver

    • getMemberSearchThreads

      int getMemberSearchThreads()
      The number of threads that will be used in a PbcsPlanType.getMemberOrAlias(String) search operation.
      Returns:
      the threads for a fixed thread pool executor

    • isIgnoreAliases

      default boolean isIgnoreAliases()
      Controls whether aliases are omitted when PbcsExplicitDimensionsPlanType.cache() pre-populates the configured member resolver. This can prevent ambiguous entries when an outline, such as an FCCS Currency dimension, contains duplicate aliases. Member names are always cached.
      Returns:
      true to omit aliases from bulk member caching
